sloka: ततस्तु ते राक्षसपुङ्गवास्त्रयो निशाचरैः पुत्रशतैश्च संवृताः ।सुरान्सहेन्द्रानृषिनागयक्षान्बबाधिरे तान्बहुवीर्यदर्पिताः ।। ७.५.४५ ॥
transliteration: tatastu te rākṣasapuṅgavāstrayo niśācaraiḥ putraśataiśca saṁvṛtāḥ ।surānsahendrānṛṣināgayakṣānbabādhire tānbahuvīryadarpitāḥ ।। 7.5.45 ॥

translations.english: Then, those three chief Rakshasas, surrounded by hundreds of their Rakshasa sons, became arrogant with their immense power and tormented the gods along with Indra, as well as the Rishis, Nagas, and Yakshas.
